blocks.tamil_translation: abundant rewards will be given,” Hazrat Mu'adh Juhani (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said this.

blocks.narrator: Hazrat Abdullah ibn Amr ibn Aas (RA)
blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللهِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْعَاصِ ﵄ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ ﷺ قَالَ: مَنْ قَرَأَ الْقُرْآنَ فَقَدِ اسْتَدْرَجَ النُّبُوَّةَ بَيْنَ جَنْبَيْهِ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ لَا يُوحَي إِلَيْهِ لَا يَنْبَغِي لِصَاحِبِ الْقُرْآنِ أَنْ يَجِدَ مَعَ مَنْ وَجَدَ وَلَا يَجْهَلَ مَعَ مَنْ جَهِلَ وَفِي جَوْفِهِ كَلَامُ اللهِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الحاكم وقال: صحيح الاسناد الترغيب: ٣٥٢/٢
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abdullah ibn Amr ibn Aas (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said, “Whoever learns the Qur'an has placed the knowledge of prophethood between his ribs, except that Wahy (revelation) alone does not come to him. It is not proper for one who has memorised the Qur'an to become angry along with those who become angry, nor to behave ignorantly along with the ignorant, because he carries within himself the words of Allah.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ جَابِرٍ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: اَلْعِلْمُ عِلْمَانِ: فَعِلْمٌ فِي الْقَلْبِ فَذَاكَ الْعِلْمُ النَّافِعُ وَعِلْمٌ عَلَي اللِّسَانِ فَذَاكَ حُجَّةُ اللهِ عَلَي ابْنِ آدَمَ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الحافظ ابوبكر الخطيب في تاريخه باسناد حسن الترغيب: ٥/ ١٠٨
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Jabir (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said, “Knowledge is of two kinds: one is that which is settled in the heart, and this is the knowledge that benefits; the other is knowledge that is on the tongue, knowledge which is not acted upon (as learnt) and is devoid of purity of heart. It is a proof from Allah against that person (that he is guilty). This Ilm will accuse him, ‘Why did you not act even though you had learnt!’”
